text:
kevin (AE): Cascade asked for a quick perf POC next week. Goal: sustained 700 RPS chat (avg ~6 tokens/req), p95 <= 220ms, they want reserved vs burst cost delta and a one-page heatmap. Also HSM in us-west3 requirement. Can we run?
alya (SE): We can run. Plan: 15m warmup, 45m steady poisson at 700 RPS, then a 10m +50% spike. Test two model targets: redwood-13b-q4 and redwood-open-7b fallback. Capture p50/p95/p99/p999, batch hist, KV hit ratio, and trace ids.
pavan (SRE): HSM note: customer-managed HSM in us-west3 will add extra key-fetch RTT. I'll deploy a KMS stub in-region to measure added latency under no-cache and cached-key configs. Also enable X-RDW-TRACE for 100% sampling.
marta (Sales Ops): For pricing, baseline tokens/sec = 700 * 6 = 4200 t/s. I'll produce reserved commit vs autoscale burst monthly numbers and a sensitivity table for +/-25% token variance. Need measured tokens/req distribution to finalize.
alya (SE): Load generator snippets (use poisson + burst):
```
# steady run
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen \n  --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 700 --duration 45m \n  --arrival poisson --warmup 15m --pfx-cache warm --prompts cascade_prompts.json

# spike phase
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 1050 --duration 10m --ramp 10s --arrival poisson
```
Collect: p50/p95/p99/p999, batch-size histogram, KV cache hit ratios, GPU util, request traces.
pavan (SRE): Add: measure KV cache priming effect by running a short prefix cache warm run (5m) and note difference in batch sizes. If HSM roundtrip adds >6ms median, we'll document cached-key fallback and security tradeoffs.
bench-bot: scheduled run 2026-04-20T13:00Z; artifacts will post to https://ci.internal/redwood/cascade/4923456789/results.tar.gz
kevin (AE): Action items: Alya = runbook + results writeup + heatmap, Marta = pricing comparison (3/12 month reserved + on-demand burst), Pavan = HSM validation + security answers. Alya please post results.json and a one-page summary for the prospect.
alya (SE): Will do. I'll run a 10m smoke tomorrow evening, then full runs Tue afternoon. Deliverables: raw results.json, 1-page heatmap, and a short ops note recommending automatic fallback to 7b when p99 > threshold.
marta (Sales Ops): I'll draft two pricing scenarios and a break-even commit calculation. Will upload slides to this thread after smoke.
pavan (SRE): I'll run the HSM stub with TTLs [no-cache, 50ms, 500ms] and post latency comparisons. If legal certs required, I'll flag here.
kevin (AE): Great — tag me when results.json is up. Thanks team :rocket:
